result.summary: Found a few visual/content issues. The most obvious broken element is an untranslated localization key shown as a section title. There are also some minor layout clipping/spacing issues in horizontally scrollable content.

issues.description: The section title displays the raw localization key `home_feed.popular_title` instead of a user-facing label.
issues.suggestion: Replace the missing translation key with the intended localized title, such as “Popular near you” or the appropriate translated string.

issues.description: Several horizontally scrollable elements are cut off at the right edge, including the category chip row and the restaurant cards in the “Fastest near you” carousel. This may be intentional, but it looks slightly abrupt without a clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent right padding, a fade/scroll hint, or ensure partially visible items are clipped cleanly so the carousel feels intentional.

issues.description: The lower restaurant card is partially obscured by the fixed bottom navigation area, making the visible content feel cramped at the bottom of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content so cards can scroll fully above the bottom navigation.
